summary: Frontend-only UI test of enlarged avatar seats, turn-glow rings, nameplates, bankroll chips, book counters, and transient reaction badges. All 7 checks in the review request pass on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Reaction badge for a seat that wins consecutive tricks keeps re-spawning so it may appear 'persistent' during a run of AI wins — that is expected (new badge per book), not a stuck badge. Verified by observing seat-W reaction across 6 x 1s snapshots while Them was on a winning streak (Books: 0 -> 11).
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Verified live on preview URL:
1) DEAL flow: cfg-speed-fast -> deal-btn -> auction visible with cyan glow on active seat (screenshot shows Them BID badge + glow while Ya'll and You dim). Passing progressed to trump selection; picking trump auto-advanced through discards into play.
2) Seats W and E render as 212x279 bordered portrait cards. Avatars: avatar_them.png (nw=1024) and avatar_yall.png (nw=1024). Nameplates 'Them' / 'Ya'll' shown, bankroll chips $100.00 present via [data-testid=seat-bankroll-W/E].
3) During play: seat-books-W ('Books: 0 / 31'), seat-books-E ('Books: 0'), seat-books-P ('You $100.00 Books: 0') all present. player-avatar renders as bottom-left 'You' card with same styling; no overlap with player-hand (seat rects top<=359 vs hand top=916 at 1920x1080).
4) 25 hand cards under [data-testid=player-hand] are visible and click registers (card play advanced trick counter Book 1/25 -> 6/25 after a few plays).
5) Reaction badge: [data-testid=reaction-W] appeared immediately after trick resolution and continued to re-appear as Them kept winning tricks (expected transient re-spawn ~1.6s cadence). reaction-E and reaction-P not observed in this run because Them dominated; the DOM node is inserted/removed by the useTableReactions hook off state.completedBooks and is not stuck.
6) No console errors, no layout breakage, background/vignette still correct.
Recipe unchanged from iter7: cfg-speed-fast -> deal-btn -> pass-btn until trump selection then trump-* to advance into play.
